title: CueCast — AI-Powered Web Testing, Built for Reliability
excerpt: Record real workflows, replay them in a real browser, and get the context you need when a run fails — without writing test scripts.

Common questions,
clear answers

What is CueCast?

CueCast is a no-code browser testing platform for web apps. Record a workflow on your product, manage it in one workspace, replay it in a real browser, and review step-level results and screenshots after every run.

Do I need to write code?

No. Record by clicking through the workflow in your browser, then refine steps, assertions, and test groups in the CueCast workspace.

What does the AI do?

AI helps clarify step intent and summarize likely causes when a run fails. Your recorded, replayable steps remain the source of truth.

How do I start?

Create a free account, install the browser extension, and record one workflow that matters — such as checkout, onboarding, or a core admin task.
